notes:
Pennsylvania has no recurring franchise-type levy on a default LLC: applies is false. The Department of Revenue's corporation-tax page says corporations operating in Pennsylvania are subject to corporate net income tax and names the selective business taxes (gross receipts for utilities, gross premiums for insurers, bank and trust company shares for financial institutions); the same page lists the capital stock and foreign franchise taxes under its own Repealed Taxes heading. A default LLC is not a subject of any of them.
collectedWithAnnualReport is null: no franchise-type levy exists, and root states.json carries annual_report_fee 7 for Pennsylvania, the Department of State's annual report filing fee - a separate payment with no tax to overlap.
stateIncomeTax: members of a partnership-classified or S-corporation-classified LLC include their shares of Pennsylvania income, loss and credit on their personal income tax returns and are taxed at the flat 3.07% personal income tax rate (2004-present). The Personal Income Tax Guide's Pass Through Entities chapter defines a Pennsylvania partnership as any unincorporated entity classified as a partnership for federal income tax purposes and lists an LLC among the examples.
hasPTETElection is false as of 2026-08-08. Pennsylvania has no enacted pass-through entity tax: the only PTET proposal in the 2025-2026 session, House Bill 1703, would add an elective tax imposed at the pass-through entity level, and the General Assembly's own status page shows it was referred to the Finance Committee on July 8, 2025 with none of the enactment milestones reached. No Department of Revenue page names a pass-through entity tax.
